#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

import openpyxl
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

# Create the workbook
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "January 2024 Expenses"

# Define categories and headers
headers = ["Date", "Category", "Description", "Amount"]
categories = ["Food", "Transport", "Entertainment", "Utilities"]

# Sample data for January 2024
data = [
    ["2024-01-01", "Food", "Grocery Store", 125.50],
    ["2024-01-02", "Transport", "Gas Station", 45.00],
    ["2024-01-03", "Entertainment", "Movie Night", 35.00],

    ["2024-01-09", "Food", "Coffee & Snacks", 22.00],
    ["2024-01-10", "Transport", "Public Transit", 15.00],
    ["2024-01-11", "Food", "Grocery Store", 98.30],
    ["2024-01-12", "Utilities", "Water Bill", 45.00],

    ["2024-01-14", "Transport", "Gas Station", 52.00],
    ["2024-01-15", "Food", "Restaurant", 85.00],
    ["2024-01-16", "Utilities", "Phone Bill", 65.00],
    ["2024-01-17", "Food", "Grocery Store", 112.40],
    ["2024-01-18", "Transport", "Gas Station", 48.00],
    ["2024-01-19", "Entertainment", "Video Games", 25.99],
    ["2024-01-20", "Food", "Fast Food", 32.50],
    ["2024-01-21", "Utilities", "Electricity", 92.00],
    ["2024-01-22", "Transport", "Parking", 18.00],
    ["2024-01-23", "Food", "Grocery Store", 105.75],
    ["2024-01-24", "Entertainment", "Streaming Sub", 15.99],
    ["2024-01-25", "Transport", "Uber/Rideshare", 42.00],
    ["2024-01-26", "Food", "Restaurant", 55.00],
    ["2024-01-27", "Utilities", "Internet", 79.99],
    ["2024-01-28", "Food", "Grocery Store", 88.25],
    ["2024-01-29", "Transport", "Gas Station", 46.50],
    ["2024-01-30", "Entertainment", "Movie Night", 30.00],
    ["2024-01-31", "Utilities", "Phone Bill", 65.00],
]

# Write headers
ws.append(headers)

# Write data rows
for row in data:
    ws.append(row)

# Calculate totals by category
# Read all data for calculation
total_rows = []
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=ws.max_row, values_only=True):
    total_rows.append(row)

# Calculate category totals
category_totals = {
    "Food": 0,
    "Transport": 0,
    "Entertainment": 0,
    "Utilities": 0
}

for row in total_rows:
    category = row[1]
    amount = row[3]
    if category in category_totals:
        category_totals[category] += amount

# Add category summary section
summary_headers = ["Category", "Total Amount"]
ws.append(summary_headers)

for category in categories:
    ws.append([category, category_totals[category]])

# Add grand total
ws.append(["", ""])
ws.append(["Grand Total", sum(category_totals.values())])

# Format currency cells
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=ws.max_row):
    if row[3]:  # Amount column
        cell = row[3]
        cell.number_format = '$0.00'
        cell.alignment = openpyxl.styles.alignment.Horizontal('center')

# Add chart
chart_data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, max_col=2, min_row=2, max_row=ws.max_row)
categories_data = Reference(ws, min_col=1, max_row=ws.max_row, min_row=2)
values = Reference(ws, min_col=3, max_col=3, min_row=2, max_row=ws.max_row)

chart = BarChart()
chart.type = 'bar'
chart.style = 10
chart.title = "Expenses by Category"
chart.x_axis.title = "Category"
chart.y_axis.title = "Amount ($)"

data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, max_row=ws.max_row, min_row=2)
categories = Reference(ws, min_col=1, max_row=ws.max_row, min_row=2)

chart.add_data(data)
chart.set_categories(categories)

chart.width = 8
chart.height = 5

# Add chart to the sheet
ws.add_chart(chart, 'G2')

# Save the workbook
wb.save('/workspace/expenses_jan2024.xlsx')

print("Expense tracker spreadsheet created successfully!")
print(f"File saved as: /workspace/expenses_jan2024.xlsx")
print(f"\nSummary:")
for category, amount in category_totals.items():
    print(f"  {category}: ${amount:.2f}")
print(f"  Grand Total: ${sum(category_totals.values()):.2f}")
